description: This file defines the Layout class within the Opencart catalog model namespace, including methods to retrieve layout and module information from the database.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Provides methods to fetch layout and module data from the database based on route, layout ID, and position.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific route from the database.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches the list of modules assigned to a specific layout and position.
